deployments_detail.use: New Progress Rail locomotives featuring AI-powered Talos energy management system

Train Inspection Portal System (TIPS): wayside machine-vision portals scan trains at track speed using 35+ cameras capturing 72 high-res images per railcar to detect undercarriage, wheel, bearing, coupler and draft-gear defects human inspectors miss; independently evaluated by the National Research Council of Canada, operational near Maple Creek, Saskatchewan. [In-house (CPKC); evaluated with National Research Council of Canada, University of Alberta, Transport Canada]
deployments_detail.value: 89% more defects detected vs manual inspection

deployments_detail.use: Optical AEI: CPKC-developed wayside sensor combining lidar, visible/infrared cameras and real-time AI to identify railcar/container equipment numbers (consist accuracy) and detect rolling-stock defects; data streamed to cloud for analysis. [In-house (CPKC)]
deployments_detail.value: 8 devices installed in Alberta and Missouri, two more by year-end; prototype in 8 weeks

deployments_detail.use: Acoustic bearing predictive maintenance: CPKC's patented algorithms analyze acoustic bearing detector data to predict wheel-bearing failures up to three months in advance, enabling proactive removal before failure. [In-house (CPKC)]

Cold wheel / automated brake-effectiveness testing: wayside detectors at the base of mountain grades feed a brake-effectiveness analysis system of algorithms measuring wheel/brake-shoe heat to flag cars with defective air brakes and support predictive maintenance. [In-house (CPKC)]
deployments_detail.value: 50% reduction in air-brake failures since 2019; ~2,600 additional cars tested annually vs manual

deployments_detail.use: Broken Rail Detection (BRD): in-house real-time electrical-circuit monitoring system that automatically detects broken rails in non-signalled (dark) territory; machine-learning algorithms added to cut false positives and predict component failure. [In-house (CPKC)]
deployments_detail.value: Machine learning reduced false-positive detections by 45%

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous track inspection fleet: autonomous Track Geometry Measurement System boxcars (including 'Total Track Assessment' cars) using lasers, machine vision and lidar to scan track geometry and rail profile; ENSCO 'combo cluster' algorithm detects low-level VTI exceptions preceding serious defects; rail-surface imaging assigns severity scores. [CPKC with ENSCO]
deployments_detail.value: 311,554 track-miles measured in 2024 (vs 118,000 in 2023); urgent defects per 100 miles down from 9.03 to 5.37

deployments_detail.use: Center of Excellence for Data Analytics and AI: dedicated data-science team applying predictive rail analytics across wayside detectors, rail-flaw (ultrasonic/induction) detection, track-stress/buckle indexing and 3D tie assessment at 60 mph. [In-house (CPKC)]
deployments_detail.value: 3 data scientists; target 15% train-accident reduction within 12 months

deployments_detail.use: Water body Hazard Monitoring System (WHMS): geohazard monitoring using AI with satellite data, synthetic-aperture radar and multispectral imagery, plus two lidar-equipped test cars, to build a data risk index of water sources near track and pre-empt washout risks. [In-house (CPKC)]
AI-assisted cross-border customs processing: analytics/AI applied to speed customs clearance across CPKC's tri-national (Canada-US-Mexico) single-line network. [CPKC (undisclosed)]
deployments_detail.value: Customs processing times reduced from weeks to hours
